title: Questions for you stand out in dark yellow
text: When an agent asks you a question, its card is now dark yellow instead of orange: frame, top line, minimap mark and pin, which shows a question mark instead of an exclamation mark. Its state line reads "Question for you" after a question-mark icon. A demo or a review waiting for approval stays orange, so a question is easy to tell apart at a glance, on the canvas and in the open card, in the dark and light theme.
